name: 6th Kup

practical.title: Pattern set by the grading examiner

theory.question: What is 3 Step Semi-Free Sparring?
theory.answer: A step beyond basic 3 step sparring: three attacks in a row, three blocks or evasions, then a counter-attack.

theory.question: What is 'Upward Punch' in Korean? (quiz widget)

sparring: Three-step sparring (Sambo Matsoki) numbers 8-10. Attack: three middle-section front punches in walking stance, starting right leg back in low block. Defences start from parallel ready stance.

8: Right L-stance, middle knifehand block to the inside twice. Counter: slide back at 45 degrees into right L-stance with forearm guarding block, right side kick landing in left L-stance, then right back fist or knifehand strike to the neck.

9: Right L-stance, middle palm push block to the outside three times. Counter: slide to the outside at 45 degrees into right L-stance with knifehand guarding block, right middle turning kick landing in vertical stance with knifehand strike to the neck.

10: Right L-stance, middle knifehand block to the inside twice. Counter: slide back at 45 degrees into right L-stance with knifehand guarding block, reverse side kick landing in right walking stance with left reverse knifehand strike to the philtrum.

Basic three-step semi-free sparring (Ban Jayoo Matsoki): attacker starts in L-stance with guarding block, either leg back; defender starts in parallel stance. Attack is back-leg-first kicking (front, side or turning kick); defence is any block suited to the kick; counter is a reverse punch.

otherSections.heading: Won-Hyo pattern (28 movements)
items: Named after the monk who brought Buddhism to the Silla Dynasty in 686 AD. Starts in Closed Ready Stance A; ends with right foot back to ready posture.
1 Twin forearm block, left foot to B (right L-stance)
2 High inward knifehand strike to B
3 Middle punch to B (left fixed stance)
4 Twin forearm block, left foot to right foot, right foot to A (left L-stance)
5 High inward knifehand strike to A
6 Middle punch to A (right fixed stance)
7 Right bending ready stance A, facing D
8 Middle side piercing kick to D
9 Knifehand guarding block to D (right L-stance)
10 Knifehand guarding block to D (left L-stance)
11 Knifehand guarding block to D (right L-stance)
12 Sun Sonkut Tulgi to D, right walking stance
13 Twin forearm block to E (right L-stance)
14 High inward knifehand strike to E
15 Middle punch to E (left fixed stance)
16 Twin forearm block, right foot to F (left L-stance)
17 High inward knifehand strike to F
18 Middle punch to F (right fixed stance)
19 Circular block to C with right inner forearm (left walking stance)
20 Low front snap kick to C (right foot)
21 Middle punch to C (right walking stance)
22 Circular block to CE with left inner forearm
23 Low front snap kick to C (left foot)
24 Middle punch to C (left walking stance)
25 Left bending ready stance A, facing C
26 Middle side piercing kick to C (right foot)
27 Middle forearm guarding block to B (right L-stance)
28 Middle forearm guarding block to A (left L-stance)
